name: ci-lane-cost
title: Cut CI lane cost in tests.yml
description: Reduce tests.yml lane cost measured 2026-08-08 over 59 runs where the bookkeeping fast lane fired only 6 times: widen the bookkeeping allowlist to docs/ and top-level markdown while staying inside the byte-identical-classifier trust model and never admitting .github/ or scripts/; move the non-gating shell-coverage job to nightly or main-only with a kcov cache; restrict the macOS leg to main-only since it would be 73 percent of billable minutes on private consumers; skip the redundant full re-run on merge to main while keeping the first-push-always-full rule.
creator: sdelmas
